description: FREE demo. Runs the real audit_workflows on a built-in SAMPLE workflow (a pull_request_target preview job) that contains typical mistakes on purpose: pwn request, script injection, missing permissions, retired runner, unpinned and deprecated actions. Shows exactly what audit_workflows returns (findings with evidence/why/fix, SHA pins, patches) before you buy a pass. Takes no arguments; it never audits your own code.
name: audit_sample
title: See a full audit on a sample (free)
